scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix shared
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix shared --if-present && npm run test --prefix server --if-present && npm run test --prefix client --if-present
